verdict.rationale: Buzz has no documented export command. Leaving is still plausible through open foundations: it is an open-source relay you can self-host on your own Postgres/S3, its data is exposed over the open Nostr NIP-29 protocol that third-party clients read directly, and its repos are standard git you can push and pull. Missing for 10: a documented bulk export of all data (messages, canvases, workflows, uploads) in open formats, any independent or hands-on confirmation that a full data exit works, and migration guidance.
